build_resnet18_model: build a ResNet18 model using PreActBlock with 2 blocks per layer for CIFAR-10 classification
build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet50 model using Bottleneck blocks with 3-4-6-3 blocks per layer for image classification
create_custom_resnet: create a custom ResNet model by passing a block type and num_blocks list to the ResNet class
run_resnet_forward: run a forward pass through a ResNet model with optional layer selection using lin and lout parameters
test_resnet_model: test a ResNet18 model by passing a random 32x32 RGB image tensor and checking output size
